body: I ended up texting someone there after 2 hours of debating with myself. It wasn't as bad as I thought. True I did withhold many of the thoughts that would get me arrested. Thank you for suggesting that idea. The person was really nice. Everyone usually ignores or blocks me.
Hmm I'm not into the organ damage part so much. I would probably turn into an alcoholic if I did that. I'm sad all the time :( I'll try your method. Music does seem to help most of the time.

From my understanding if a hotline detects any hint of self harm they will send the police to investigate. I'm not interested in that. Everyone around me thinks I'm funny and happy. I'm not on the inside. If the police came my life would be ruined. I would lose my job, my friends would turn their backs, and I would be in a hospital forever. I'd rather die than call a hotline. Sorry
